title: Florida House, District 90
what_it_does: Represents District 90 (Part of Palm Beach) in the Florida House; votes on state laws and the state budget.
verified_ballot_note: Candidate list taken from the Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list on 2026-09-18 (https://dos.elections.myflorida.com/candidates/CanList.asp); statuses Qualified/Unopposed only. Counties from the Legislature's district listings. Positions have not been researched yet.

candidates.name: Ionel Roiban
candidates.background: Ionel Roiban is a software and AI engineer who has lived in Boynton Beach for 25 years and is running for office for the first time. He describes himself as a private-sector outsider running a data-driven campaign focused on affordability and local issues rather than national politics.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

property_tax.summary: His site says he backs Amendment 3 and would help write its implementing law, and supports phasing out non-school property taxes on homesteads; he says he is voting yes.
property_tax.quote: I'm voting yes — and asking for a seat in the majority that writes the implementing law.

candidates.name: Rob Long
candidates.occupation: Civil engineer; former Delray Beach city commissioner; state representative since December 2025
candidates.background: Rob Long is a civil engineer with a degree from Penn State and an MBA from the University of Florida. He served on the Delray Beach City Commission and as an elected Palm Beach Soil & Water Conservation District supervisor, and founded a grassroots engagement firm. He won a December 2025 special election for District 90 and is seeking a full term.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

property_tax.summary: He voted no on HJR 203 (Feb. 19, 2026), his site opposes the governor's property tax amendment as shifting costs to renters and small businesses, and he called the amendment a 'shell game' in August 2026. He did not vote on HJR 1-F.
property_tax.quote: The governor is going to blow a hole in your city or county's budget and then blame the city or county for trying to patch it up.
